title: ClipCapture
description: Sidecar uploaded with every assessment clip (ADR-013). Lets the server analyse the clip against true vertical and real frame timing instead of the phone's edges and arrival time. Contains no identifiers beyond the pseudonymous session.

stepId.description: Step id from the assessment battery, e.g. "static.anterior".

view.description: Which side of the body faces the camera. left_lateral = the person's left side faces the camera.

width.description: Encoded frame width in pixels, after applying the clip's orientation.

frames.description: One entry per encoded frame, in order.

t.description: Seconds since the clip's first frame (presentation timestamp).

gravity.description: Unit gravity direction in the camera frame C of the oriented image: x = image right, y = image down, z = optical axis away from the camera. A level phone filming upright yields approximately [0, 1, 0].

intrinsics.description: Pinhole intrinsics in pixels for the oriented image, when the device reports them.
